partition: First contiguous official multistream XML shard p1p41242; selected before any new question and without title selection
scope: Primary revision/provenance repair pilot, not 1.25 million admitted full articles or 2–3 million target
source: Wikimedia official dump metadata and published SHA1 plus acquired SHA256
raw_retention: Original compressed archive retained; each decoded revision text has exact SHA1, SHA256 and compressed storage; no FineWiki text substituted
rights: Article URL is permitted attribution; preserve history/revision URLs and bundled license; all unreviewed additional attribution/quotation/template dispositions remain pending, never automatically research-admitted
audit: All page/revision/text identities and SHA1 checked; deterministic minimum SHA256(page ID) representative per 16 partitions, not convenient named articles; fixtures do not certify corpus-wide rights
mapping: Exact unchanged plain paragraphs only, UTF16 source offsets, no template/math stripping; markup-bearing paragraphs remain original raw source and excluded from candidate projection
research_admission: No automatic clearance from official origin, hash, source count, keyword filter or sample review
